Interviewer: How do you usually manage your grocery shopping?
P2: I always make a list before I go. I never just wing it at the store.
Interviewer: What happened last Sunday?
P2: I forgot to bring the list and ended up buying random things. I got distracted.
Interviewer: What about budgeting?
P2: I try to stick to a budget every month. I track every purchase in a spreadsheet.
Interviewer: And last month?
P2: I actually went over by quite a bit. I didn't track anything in January.
